d: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is under intense scrutiny after admitting to an affair with Alice Huang, a Megaspeed executive whom U.S. officials reportedly believed was a Chinese intelligence asset. Nvidia has launched an independent investigation, while saying its board has no reason to believe company secrets or U.S. national security were compromised. The concern centres on Huang’s extraordinary access.
